summary: Verified vendor order notifications end-to-end: backend /orders returns employee_name + items for vendor and employee; vendor Orders UI shows employee name and itemized 'qty× name' list; VendorOrderNotifier bell renders on vendor pages and is hidden for employees; inserting a new order via scripts/insert_test_order.py caused the polling notifier to show a toast (within ~8s) with '2× Tea +1 more from diag_zero' + unread badge=1; clicking the bell navigates to /vendor/orders and clears the badge; employee Orders page shows 'Ordered by diag_zero' line. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: VendorOrderNotifier polls every 15s and unconditionally sends /api/orders even on non-vendor pages until unmount; fine, but consider skipping when document.hidden to save requests.
Notifier only inspects items[0] for the toast label ('2× Tea +1 more'); acceptable for a summary but items>1 users have to open the page to see the rest — already handled by the +N more suffix.
seenIds is memory-only; a hard refresh will re-bootstrap and suppress toasts for orders that arrived during reload. Acceptable trade-off for MVP polling.
test_credentials: Vendor diag_vendor@diag.com / Diag#1234; Employee diag_zero@diag.com / Diag#1234
seed_data_creation: Re-used existing DIAG scenario; ran scripts/insert_test_order.py which inserted a new paid order (CRV-139579, 2× Tea + 1× Samosa) from diag_zero for DIAG_Vendor during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification feature works. Verified data-testids in play: vendor-notification-bell, vendor-notification-count, new-order-toast-{id}, vendor-order-employee-{id}, vendor-order-items-{id}, order-employee-{id}. Poll cadence 15s but first poll runs immediately; toast fired at ~8s after insert. Employee /orders returns their own orders; vendor /orders returns vendor's orders. To simulate a new order, cd /app/backend && python3 scripts/insert_test_order.py.
